spec.description:
Worst of each service's checks over the last 2m: DOWN, UNKNOWN (a check has no data), or UP. History: the status timeline. Click a tile: detail dashboard.

- **nginx**: nginx.service active + stub_status (nginx_up)
- **paseo**: paseo + paseo-relay units active + both HTTPS probes
- **nixbot**: nixbot.service active + scrape up + ci.phlip9.com probe
- **niks3**: niks3.service active + scrape up + cache.phlip9.com probe
- **postgres**: postgresql.service active + exporter can query it (pg_up)
- **nix-daemon**: nix-daemon.socket active + nix-daemon.service not failed (the service is socket activated, so inactive is ok)
- **github-webhook**: github-webhook.service active + sauna.phlip9.com/healthz probe
- **grafana**: grafana.service active + scrape up + HTTPS probe + Git Sync repository health checks pass (< 2 failed in 15m)
- **victoriametrics**: victoriametrics.service active + self-scrape up
- **alerting**: vmalert + alertmanager units active + scrapes up + the Watchdog alert is being written (DOWN if not: the alert feed is stale). A dead pipeline also stops the healthchecks.io Watchdog pings
- **profiling**: alloy + pyroscope units active + scrapes up
spec.title: Services

spec.description: Share of time all tasks in the cgroup stalled on memory, averaged over each step. systemd-oomd kills the worst child of workload.slice or a user-<uid>.slice at > 80% for 30s: the red line is only reached by sustained thrash; a 30s spike reads far lower here.
